blocks.arabic_text: لَتَأْمُرُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلَتَنْهَوُنَّ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ، وَلَتَأْخُذُنَّ عَلي يَدَيِ الظَّالِمِ، وَلَتَأْطِرُنَّهُ عَلي الْحَقِّ أَطْرًا، وَلَتَقْصُرُنَّهُ عَلَي الْحَقِّ قَصْرًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب الامر والنهي، رقم:٤٣٣٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “The first decline that came upon the Children of Israel was this: when a man met his friend, he would say, “Friend, fear Allah Ta'ala! Give up what you are doing, for what you are doing is not proper for you.” Then, when he met him the next day, even though the other had not listened to what he said, because of his friendship with him he would join him in eating, drinking and sitting in gatherings just as before. When this state became widespread and they abandoned the work of enjoining good and forbidding evil, Allah Ta'ala made the hearts of the good hard like the hearts of the evil.” Having said this, the Prophet ﷺ recited from the ayah beginning (لُعِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ م بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلي لِسَانِ دَاوُدَ وَعِيسَي بْنِ مَرْيَم) up to (فَاسِقُونَ). (The meaning of the earlier two ayahs is) “The Bani Israel were cursed by the tongue of Hazrat Dawud (AS) and Hazrat Isa (AS). The reason for this is that they disobeyed and went on transgressing the limits. They did not stop one another from the evil they were engaged in. Truly, this deed of theirs was most evil.” After that the Prophet ﷺ commanded with great emphasis, “You must keep on enjoining good and keep on forbidding evil. Keep stopping the oppressor from oppression, and drag him towards the truth. Make him stand firm upon the truth.”” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ نِ الصِّدِّيقِ ﵁ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ! إِنَّكُمْ
